plan.notes: Transcribed from the official College of Marin Career Education Catalog (cte.marin.edu, Academic Year 2022-2023), Fire Technology program page. PROGRAM OFFERINGS lists 'Skills Certificate, Emergency Medical Technician Training Course (7.0 units)'. The CORE CLASSES list includes 'FIRE 112 - Emergency Medical Technician I (7 units, CSU)', which alone satisfies the 7.0-unit certificate; FIRE 215 (3), FIRE 120A (1.5) and FIRE 120B (3) are separate courses (the 120A/B are refresher courses for expiring certificates) and are excluded. Modeled as a single-semester skills certificate. The AA in Public Safety (60 units) has no official term sequence and is NOT collected (honest negative). All classes at Indian Valley Campus; scheduling subject to change.
